# superset_saved_query (Resource)

Manages a saved SQL query in Superset.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "superset_saved_query" "example" {
  database_id = superset_database.example.id
  label       = "Count active users"
  sql         = "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ab_user WHERE active = true"
  schema      = "public"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database_id` (Number) ID of the database this query belongs to.
- `label` (String) Display name of the saved query.
- `sql` (String) SQL text of the query.

### Optional

- `catalog` (String) Optional catalog name for the query.
- `description` (String) Optional description of the saved query.
- `extra_json` (String) JSON string of extra metadata for the saved query.
- `schema` (String) Optional schema name for the query.
- `template_parameters` (String) JSON string of Jinja template parameters used in the SQL.

### Read-Only

- `database_name` (String) Name of the database this query belongs to (read from API).
- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the saved query.
